steps.do: Greet the customer politely and ask how you can help. Share no account information before the customer is verified.
If the customer has not already said, ask which credit card they want to refer people to and what referral terms they believe apply: the bonus, the qualifying spend and the time window.
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Search the knowledge base, by keyword and by meaning, for a referral program document for that exact card (for example '<card name> Referral Program'), and open the full document. Referral program documents exist for: EcoCard, Silver Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card and Silver Zoom Card. No referral program document was found for Crypto-Cash Back, Bronze Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card or Diamond Elite Card.

steps.do: Decide whether the card has a documented referral program that still accepts new referrals at the current time. The Business Gold Rewards Card accepts new referrals only until 2025-09-15. The Silver Zoom Card accepts none after 2025-10-01.

steps.do: Tell the customer politely that you could not find a documented Rho-Bank referral program for this card, or that its program no longer accepts new referrals, so you cannot provide a referral link. Do not give the referral tool. Do not offer or make a transfer to a human, even if the customer says they have an official letter or offer. Share another card's documented terms only if the customer asks. Then stop for this card.
steps.if: no documented referral program exists for the card, or its program has closed to new referrals
steps.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

steps.do: Compare the customer's claimed terms with the documented program of the card they named: bonus amount, qualifying spend, time window and annual cap. Compare only against that card's own document. Terms that match a different card's program (for example $100 for $3,000 within 90 days is the Business Silver Rewards Card, not the Silver Zoom Card) are still a mismatch. If they differ, explain the correct documented terms. Give no referral tool and do not transfer. Stop for this card, unless the customer then accepts the correct documented terms and still wants the link.
steps.if: a documented, open program exists for the card
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Decide whether a new referral would be rejected automatically. Count the referral bonuses received in the rolling 7 days before the current time, across all credit card types. If there are 2 or more, a new referral would be denied. Also review any REJECTED or ERROR statuses.
steps.quote: This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

steps.do: Explain that the customer has reached the limit of 2 referral bonuses in a rolling 7-day window, so a new referral would be denied automatically. Tell them to wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap. Give no referral tool and do not transfer. Stop.
steps.if: a new referral would be rejected automatically
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

open_questions: The Crypto-Cash Back documents (doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_001 to 009) never mention a referral program. The workflow treats this as 'no documented program'.
The documents do not say which get_referrals_by_user statuses count as a 'received bonus' for the rolling 7-day limit (COMPLETE only, or pending ones too).
No document says whether the referrer must hold the card they refer people to.

If a customer accepts the corrected documented terms after a mismatch, doc 009 does not say clearly whether the tool may then be given. The library allows it when the customer accepts the correct terms and still wants the link.
Annual per-card caps are documented, but no document says the agent must check them before giving the link.
